summary: PDPV Tickets Iteration 19 - Acceptance Questionnaire Feature tested. All 12 backend tests pass. Frontend acceptance modal with 3 intent options (agendar/avancar/contactar), date picker, and period selector (manha/tarde) working correctly. Fixed missing acceptance_intent fields in TicketResponse schema.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (acceptance modal, rejection modal, all flows verified)

seed_data_creation: Created test tickets with quote options and quote links for UI testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Acceptance questionnaire feature fully tested. The POST /api/public/quote/{token}/respond endpoint accepts acceptance_intent ('agendar', 'avancar', 'contactar'), preferred_date, and preferred_period fields. These are saved to the ticket and returned via GET /api/tickets/{id}. Frontend shows acceptance modal with 3 options when clicking Accept. Selecting 'agendar' shows date picker and morning/afternoon selector. All regression tests pass (login, public branding, tire analysis report, rejection flow).

acceptance_questionnaire.description: New acceptance intent modal with 3 options: agendar (schedule), avancar (proceed), contactar (contact)

acceptance_intent_agendar.description: Schedule for specific date with date picker and morning/afternoon selector

acceptance_intent_avancar.description: Proceed with service - no additional fields required

acceptance_intent_contactar.description: Customer wants to be contacted - no additional fields required

rejection_flow.description: Rejection modal with 7 reason options still works correctly

backward_compatibility.description: Acceptance without intent fields still works (old behavior)

bug_fix_applied.issue: acceptance_intent fields not returned in GET /api/tickets/{id} response
bug_fix_applied.fix: Added acceptance_intent, acceptance_intent_label, preferred_date, preferred_period to TicketResponse schema in /app/backend/schemas/ticket.py
